This '''Jawa''' worked at a junkyard on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droids]] were put together from existing parts by workers. The [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] praised and encouraged workers when they succeeded, but became irritated when they were not able to build the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] fast enough based on the Jawa's specifications.<ref name="JJD" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Jawa was also seen in the non-canon ''[[Star Wars Galactic Spy]]'' game, having left the junkyard to search for droids in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWGS">{{SWArchive|url=play/online-games/galactic-spy|text=''Star Wars Galactic Spy''|int=Star Wars Galactic Spy}}</ref>
